# Data Scientist, Energy Demand Forecasting

**Lynfjord Power A/S** · Copenhagen (hybrid, two days a week in the office) · 2 positions

Lynfjord Power supplies electricity and district heating to 300,000 homes. Our forecasting
team predicts hourly demand so we buy the right amount of power, and we are growing it
with two data scientists.

## What you will do

- Build and improve hourly and daily demand forecasts for electricity and heat.
- Combine weather forecasts, calendars and meter data in your models.
- Explain forecast uncertainty to the trading desk.

## What we are looking for

- At least 3 years of experience with forecasting or similar modelling work.
- Solid Python for data work and modelling.
- Strong experience with time series forecasting.
- A good grasp of statistics, including uncertainty and prediction intervals.
- Working SQL.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

## Nice to have

- Bayesian statistics or probabilistic forecasting.
- Gradient boosting models such as LightGBM or XGBoost.
- Experience from energy, utilities or weather data.

We offer a permanent position, flexible hours and a pension scheme.
